Control: Find the overshared sites before Copilot does
Licence: Data access governance reports and EEEU insights are part of SharePoint Advanced Management, which Microsoft includes with Microsoft 365 Copilot licences. DSPM data risk assessments need Microsoft Purview (check your plan). SharePoint Administrator role.
Verify: A list of high-risk sites with an owner for each exists in the tracker, and the DAG/EEEU reports are saved with the date they were run.

Control: Hide the riskiest sites from Copilot while you fix them (Restricted Content Discovery)
Licence: Microsoft 365 Copilot licence (SharePoint Advanced Management included). SharePoint sites only, not OneDrive. SharePoint Administrator role.
Verify: Every high-risk site from CR01 either has access fixed or has 'Restrict content from Microsoft Copilot' on, with a removal date in the tracker. A pilot user's Copilot answer no longer cites the restricted site.

Control: Make 'Specific people, view' the default sharing link and put an expiry on Anyone links
Licence: Any SharePoint Online plan. SharePoint Administrator role.
Verify: Check output shows DefaultSharingLinkType = Direct, DefaultLinkPermission = View, and either Anyone links not allowed or RequireAnonymousLinksExpireInDays set to a value greater than 0.

Control: Remove 'Everyone except external users' from sensitive sites and hide it in the people picker
Licence: Site access reviews and EEEU insights: SharePoint Advanced Management (included with Microsoft 365 Copilot licences). People picker setting: any SharePoint Online plan.
Verify: Sensitive sites from CR01 no longer grant EEEU; the next EEEU insights report shows fewer items; ShowEveryoneExceptExternalUsersClaim is False.

Control: Confirm Copilot interactions are audited and searchable
Licence: Audit (Standard), included in Microsoft 365 business and enterprise plans. Longer audit retention needs Audit (Premium) or a retention add-on. Audit Logs or View-Only Audit Logs role.
Verify: UnifiedAuditLogIngestionEnabled is True and a CopilotInteraction search for a pilot user returns results; the retention decision is recorded.
